CRITICAL: Site-wide Person + WebSite schema and index CollectionPage schema never reach served HTML — rendered via next/script and RSC flight payload, invisible to crawlers (layout.tsx regression)
HIGH: Broken default social image — /twitter-image.jpg returns 404, breaks og:image/twitter:image on 6 pages
HIGH: Mobile LCP 4.7s (POOR) driven by 424KB JS + GA4 (167KB, 42% unused) preloaded high-priority; hero image lacks fetchpriority=high
HIGH: Domain migrated from rokyuddin.vercel.app (now 404, no redirect) to new rokyuddin.com created 2026-08-19 — no link equity transfer, near-zero authority
MEDIUM: Blog is dormant and extremely thin — 3 posts from Nov 2024 at ~135-200 words each claiming '5-8 min read'; 'Modern Web Design Trends 2024' is structurally obsolete in 2026
MEDIUM: No About page, no standalone Contact page, no persistent footer on content pages; empty 'Client Testimonials' section
quick_wins: Fix layout.tsx: replace next/script <Script> with plain <script type=application/ld+json> for Person+WebSite (5-min fix, makes site-wide schema visible)
Set NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL=https://www.rokyuddin.com to resolve the canonical/www conflict across all channels
Add priority (fetchpriority=high) to the hero <Image> and stop high-priority-preloading GA4
Fill or remove the empty Client Testimonials section

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: All 10 pages return 200 and are indexable (no noindex/X-Robots-Tag on main pages)
HTTPS enforced (308 on both hosts), HSTS present (max-age=63072000)
Valid XML sitemap, /sanity correctly Disallowed + noindexed
Viewport + lang=en on all pages, trailing-slash normalization correct, no dead links
Responsive single-host mobile (no m. duplication)

findings.title: www/non-www canonical conflict (self-contradicting setup)
findings.description: Site serves on www.rokyuddin.com (non-www 308-redirects to www on every path), but SITE_URL (src/lib/site.ts, default non-www) drives all 10 canonicals, og:url, metadataBase, robots Host/Sitemap, sitemap <loc>, and schema URLs to non-www — a host that redirects back to www. Every declared canonical points at a URL that 308s.
findings.recommendation: Set NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL=https://www.rokyuddin.com (or change the site.ts default); keep the 308; resubmit sitemap and confirm https://www.rokyuddin.com GSC property.

findings.title: Broken default social image (/twitter-image.jpg returns 404)
findings.description: DEFAULT_SOCIAL_IMAGE='/twitter-image.jpg' 404s; real dynamic route is /twitter-image (200, PNG). Breaks og:image/twitter:image on 6 pages (blog index, 3 posts, case-studies index, playground). Homepage uses a Sanity OG image instead (~1MB, oversized).

findings.title: Missing security headers
findings.description: Only HSTS set (no includeSubDomains/preload). No CSP, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, X-Frame-Options, or Permissions-Policy.
findings.recommendation: Add security headers via next.config.ts or Cloudflare; strengthen HSTS once the www host is finalized.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Strong homepage E-E-A-T: named employers with dates, 3+ years, public resume, verifiable contact (email/phone/location)
Case studies are substantive engineering narratives with dated, specific detail (durations, teams, outcomes)
Clear H2/H3 passage structure ideal for extraction

findings.title: Blog is dormant and extremely thin (3 posts, Nov 2024, ~135-200 words)
findings.description: All 3 blog posts date Nov 2024 (~21 months stale), run ~135-200 words while claiming '5-8 min read'. 'Modern Web Design Trends 2024' is structurally time-obsolete. Cannot win their target SERPs in 2026 and drags down E-E-A-T recency perception.
findings.recommendation: Refresh with current-dated deep posts (1500-2500 words with real code/data), or soft-remove the 2024 trends post and stubs until they meet depth.

findings.title: Missing About, Contact pages and persistent footer
findings.description: No About page, no standalone Contact page, no persistent footer on content pages — 'Get in Touch' on blog/case-study pages points to an #contact anchor that only exists on the homepage.
findings.recommendation: Add About + Contact pages and a site-wide footer with contact/social links.

findings.title: Empty Client Testimonials section
findings.description: Homepage renders '04 Client Testimonials' heading with testimonials:[] (empty) — a visible trust/E-E-A-T hole.
findings.recommendation: Fill with 2-3 named, role-attributed testimonials, or remove the section.

findings.title: Case-study metrics unverifiable / duplicate descriptions
findings.description: Headline results (99.9% uptime, 100% accessibility, 10x) are self-reported with no source/screenshot; the same description is duplicated verbatim across homepage card, index card, and page meta description (self-competition).
findings.recommendation: Back each metric with a link/screenshot; differentiate descriptions across URLs.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: All 10 pages have unique title tags and meta descriptions
All pages have canonical tags; homepage H1 'Md Rokyuddin' present above the fold (server-rendered)
Clear heading hierarchy (H1 > H2 > H3) across pages

findings.title: Every blog post has two H1 tags
findings.description: Duplicate H1 (visible H1 plus a repeated in-body H1) on all 3 blog posts.
findings.recommendation: Keep exactly one H1 per page.

findings.title: Duplicate meta descriptions / copy across case-study URLs
findings.description: Case-study meta description = Project Overview paragraph = homepage/index card text; blog index cards repeat meta description as intro.

findings.title: Playground has no H1 and minimal on-page content
findings.description: Playground is a JS-driven tool page with almost no server-rendered SEO content and no H1.
findings.recommendation: Add a page H1 and a short intro paragraph.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: src/lib/schema.ts has well-structured builders (Person, WebSite, BlogPosting, Article, BreadcrumbList, CollectionPage) with @ids, publisher, keywords
Detail pages (3 blog posts with BlogPosting, 3 case studies with Article) emit real server-rendered <script type=application/ld+json>

findings.title: Site-wide Person + WebSite schema is invisible to crawlers (next/script + RSC)
findings.description: layout.tsx renders Person + WebSite via next/script <Script> (afterInteractive), which does not emit server HTML — the JSON-LD only lives in the RSC flight payload (self.__next_f.push). Homepage serves 0 real <script type=application/ld+json> tags. Index CollectionPage schema (blog/case-studies) also collapses into the flight payload under Cache Components. Only detail pages emit real schema.
findings.recommendation: Replace the two next/script <Script> tags in layout.tsx with plain <script type=application/ld+json> elements; verify /blog + /case-studies CollectionPage flush to static HTML; re-verify with curl | grep and Google Rich Results Test.

findings.title: Case studies typed as generic Article; no BreadcrumbList served; Person author not @id-linked
findings.description: Case studies use @type Article (should be TechArticle/CreativeWork); no BreadcrumbList in served HTML; BlogPosting/Article authors declared inline without @id to a global Person node; case studies lack datePublished; sameAs missing X.
findings.recommendation: Convert to TechArticle + BreadcrumbList, add full dates, tie all author/publisher to @id https://rokyuddin.com/#person, expand sameAs.

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: Desktop fast: Performance 91, LCP 1.3s (good)
CLS = 0 on both mobile & desktop (stable layout)
All images next/image; fonts self-hosted via next/font (no Google Fonts dependency); correct preloads

findings.title: Mobile LCP 4.7s (POOR) driven by JS + third-party
findings.description: Mobile lab: Performance 68, LCP 4.7s, FCP 3.0s, TBT 310ms. 424KB JS across 18 scripts (1.2MB un-minified), ~116KB unused JS, GA4 gtag.js (167KB, 42% unused) preloaded at High priority steals connection slot from LCP image. Hero image preloaded but lacks fetchpriority=high. No CrUX field data (low traffic).
findings.recommendation: Add priority to the hero <Image>; stop high-priority-preloading GA4 (or drop GA4, keep Cloudflare analytics); trim unused JS; shrink oversized 1536x1024 case-study images.

findings.title: Double analytics (GA4 + Cloudflare Web Analytics)
findings.description: Both GA4 (gtag.js 167KB) and Cloudflare beacon.min.js present — redundant ~180KB third-party.
findings.recommendation: Keep one analytics tool for a portfolio; defer GA4.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: All AI crawlers allowed (robots.txt User-Agent: * Allow: /) — no bot blocked
llms.txt present with above-average quality (name, role, stack, location, contact)
Citability 68/100 — homepage + AltSEO case study are strong, quotable, hedge-free
Clear H1>H2>H3 passage structure; clean entity definition in content

findings.title: llms-full.txt missing (404)
findings.description: llms.txt exists but /llms-full.txt returns 404; no per-page summaries of the most quotable case studies.
findings.recommendation: Add llms-full.txt with expanded bio + per-case-study metric summaries; add X handle to Contact.

findings.title: Blog posts not citable (generic, fact-free)
findings.description: Blog posts contain almost no numbers/dates/original data — a model would cite Next.js docs instead of the post.
findings.recommendation: Inject 2-4 concrete first-person data points per post (Lighthouse delta, bundle-size, latency).

findings.title: Homepage entity schema invisible to AI crawlers
findings.description: AI crawlers reading raw HTML get ZERO schema on the homepage (Person/WebSite only in RSC payload) — the page most important for entity binding.
findings.recommendation: Render homepage Person+WebSite schema as static server HTML.

categories.name: Images
what_works: All images use next/image with alt text (verified 13 images on homepage, none missing alt)
CLS 0 — images have dimensions or are lazy-loaded
Responsive srcset/sizes emitted correctly

findings.title: Oversized case-study images (1536x1024 served at ~750px)
findings.description: Case-study thumbnails source from Sanity at 1536x1024 PNG but display ~500-750px — ~69KB waste; homepage OG image is ~1MB.
findings.recommendation: Request smaller w/crops from Sanity; confirm WebP/AVIF delivery; compress the OG image.

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes
items: Fix layout.tsx: replace next/script <Script> with plain <script type=application/ld+json> for Person + WebSite (site-wide schema becomes visible) — 5 min
Resolve www/non-www canonical conflict: set NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL=https://www.rokyuddin.com (fixes canonicals, sitemap, robots Host, OG, schema URLs at once); resubmit sitemap in GSC
Verify /blog + /case-studies CollectionPage schema flushes to static HTML (Cache Components), re-test with curl | grep + Rich Results Test
Fix broken DEFAULT_SOCIAL_IMAGE (/twitter-image.jpg -> /twitter-image) affecting 6 pages

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: Improve mobile LCP: add priority/fetchpriority=high to hero Image; stop high-priority-preloading GA4 or drop it (keep Cloudflare analytics)
Trim unused JS (~116KB) and de-duplicate double analytics; lazy-load below-the-fold sections to cut TBT/INP
Add About page + standalone Contact page + persistent site footer with social/contact links
Refresh or restructure the blog: update to 2026-dated deep posts, retitle/remove 'Modern Web Design Trends 2024', add first-person data to make posts citable
Fill or remove the empty Client Testimonials section
Fix duplicate H1s on blog posts and duplicate meta descriptions

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & Authority
items: Build hub-and-spoke content clusters (Next.js, TypeScript, Frontend Performance, React, Design Engineering) — publish long-tail spokes before pillars
Internal-link case studies + homepage authority into blog clusters (Rydr/AltSEO/Skinsight to relevant posts)
Back case-study metrics with screenshots/links; convert case-study schema to TechArticle + BreadcrumbList
Address domain migration: re-claim/redirect rokyuddin.vercel.app, replace old URL in velora-ui repo + bios; point high-authority profiles (GitHub, LinkedIn, dev.to) at canonical URL
Add security headers (CSP, nosniff, Referrer-Policy)
Expand llms.txt + add llms-full.txt; add homepage FAQ + FAQPage schema

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring & Iteration
items: Verify CrUX field CWV once traffic grows past eligibility (~1k Chrome pageviews/28 days); connect GSC if credentials available
Add fetchpriority and image-size hygiene to new content; subset fonts (subset:['latin'])
Track long-tail rankings first, then earned links, then head terms (6-12 months)
Re-run this audit as a drift baseline after deploying the critical fixes
